name: MONAD · 30-minute chain showcase
description: One visit, three links: QR truth to the API, fleet capture through labelled blocks, and a session upload with a clock fit. Nothing to associate to and nothing to configure — start it and walk.

config.description:
A chain test, not a measurement. Nothing here is a result: the point is to prove that a scan reaches the API, that the fleet's injected stream is being captured while the blocks are labelled, and that the session uploads with a usable clock fit.

The phone does not illuminate — it marks block boundaries and carries the truth channel. Illumination is monad01 injecting on 2.4 GHz ch11.
Stamps a wallclock and a monotonic timestamp. Two sync samples are the minimum the clock gate G4 accepts, so this scan and the closing one are not ceremony.
Leave the marked zone entirely. 175 s — the frozen sub-block length, so this take is comparable with next week's rather than a one-off.
One person, seated, still. The still crowd is the condition that has never been measured on this hardware.
Same person, walking a steady loop at an ordinary pace. Motion-versus-static at a fixed count is the cleanest contrast available in one visit.
Second clock sample. With fewer than two the fold is flagged and the session is unusable for any joint analysis — the status screen says so before you leave the room.
Check three things: that monad03 captured through the block, the clock gate on the status screen, and the tally at /admin/lab/sessions. If all three agree, the chain is real.
